description: Create comprehensive README.md with project overview, setup instructions, architecture explanation, and usage guide. Ensure all final polish and integration between frontend and backend is complete.
steps: Create README.md with: Project title and description, features list, tech stack explanation (Node.js built-in modules only, no external dependencies), setup instructions (clone, copy .env.example to .env, add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, run npm start), usage guide, API documentation for POST /api/roast and GET /api/health, roast intensity levels explanation, file format support notes, architecture overview, environment variables documentation

Final integration check: verify the full flow works end-to-end by reviewing that frontend POST matches backend expectations for both JSON and multipart requests, verify error responses are handled by frontend, verify static file serving works for all public/ assets
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists with clear setup and usage instructions
README documents the API endpoints with request/response examples
The full application flow is coherent: frontend sends requests that backend expects, backend returns responses that frontend renders
verification: README.md exists and contains setup instructions including npm start command
All referenced files in README actually exist in the project
